name: Permuted Matrix Initialization
description: The matrix values are provided with permuted axes (rows mapped to buses 2, 3, 1 and columns mapped to 3, 1, 2). This defeats models that rely on surface pattern matching to blindly extract a 3x3 array and map it sequentially to indices 1, 2, 3, which would result in a broken, asymmetric truth table. Models that genuinely read the text will correctly map the coordinates, recover the true symmetric constraint, and succeed.
